fusions.name: Triple Nock
fusions.desc: Looses 3 tines at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Full Draw Length
fusions.desc: A drawn shot at a target up to 9 tiles away that deals 28 damage, rising to twice that at full reach. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Strung Stave
fusions.desc: Plants the haft as a strung stave that stands for 15 seconds and shoots an enemy within 6 tiles for 5 damage every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Spare Tine
fusions.desc: Once every 12 seconds, when you strike, a spare tine flies at the nearest enemy within 8 tiles and deals 10 damage.
